summary: This PR is documentation/tracking-only: it appends historical task sections to PROGRESS.md (a reconstruction effort, consistent with the preceding commits 9d3bd0f4/0afa4d96/37b0345e visible in git log), adds a new independent re-audit report (ai-os/audits/projexa_erp_e2e_reaudit_2026-07-27.md) covering 5 previously-merged PRs, and registers/updates a claim entry in ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml following the established protocol. No source code, schema, migration, auth, or CI/workflow files are touched, and the diff is purely additive (475 insertions, 0 deletions), so the tier1 classification (additive, low-blast-radius, docs) is correct. Spot-checking several of the audit report's specific factual claims against the live repo (computeHierarchicalAmount's root-ancestor-walk logic and circular-reference/missing-parent errors in construction-boq-service.ts, the existence and shape of construction-valuation-service.ts, computeInvoiceTaxTotals in erp-invoicing-service.ts, and the roster parameter threaded through aggregateDesignerTimesheetCosts/designerTimesheetReport in construction-reports-service.ts) confirmed the report's file:line citations and described behavior are accurate rather than fabricated. No security, correctness, or architecture issues found in this diff.
